command.reason: AI-assisted technical source review under the administrator's authorization, including an independent review workstream; not an external human audit. Exact submission source, protected build, compiler/input/bytecode and canonical host manifest checked. Reviewed the full constructor-valid configuration range, external dependencies, callback liveness/manipulation, budget/management roles and composition. Hosted smoke checks alone do not prove hot-path behavior; the exact host-profile tests supply additional coverage. Approval is for this immutable package and manifest; onchain publication, lifecycle/finality and public availability remain separate gates. Every-Nth-buy rewards are deterministic and use only their prefunded isolated ETH budget; exhausted rewards are skipped without debt. Beneficiary claims survive expiry and unused-budget refund. The refund wallet is fixed, separate from creator/CTO and author wallets, and expiry must be in the future. Combined cap rejection rolls back the trade and credits. Use the reviewed address configuration schema and management controls.
